chunks: The mountains will be like the tufts of carded wool.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the state of mountains on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this imagery underscores the absolute power of Allah to dismantle the most enduring symbols of worldly stability, serving as a reminder of the transient nature of material existence. The transformation of mountains into 'carded wool' (al-'ihn al-manfush) highlights the complete reversal of natural order, preparing the earth for the final reckoning where all claims of permanence are nullified.
